protocol.phase_to_engine_offset_rule: positive flexor-minus-extensor activity maps to positive sin(engine phase), the swing half-cycle

real_grouping.rule: anchor leg T1L; same if |wrapped phase| < 0.25 cycles, anti if within 0.25 cycles of 0.5; cosine sign only at boundary

method1_reference.reason: continuous per-leg phase already carries inter-leg phase offsets; adding Method-1 group offset would duplicate them

protocol.phase_definition: analytic phase of band-passed mean flexor-minus-extensor antagonist activity

continuous_phase.definition: circular phase coherence of continuous per-leg engine phase; canonical tripod groups used only for reporting
